requirement: Describe the study as prospective, multicenter, randomized, double-blind for participants and examiners, active parallel controlled, with bilateral implantation.

evidence.text: 本临床试验采用前瞻性、多中心、随机、双盲（受试者和检查者）、阳性产品平行对照、双眼植入的试验设计。

notes: Equivalent professional wording is acceptable.

requirement: State central randomization and a 1:1 allocation ratio.

evidence.text: 利用中央随机系统进行受试者随机，保证受试者被1:1均衡地分配到试验组或对照组。

notes: Center is also a randomization stratification factor elsewhere in the protocol and should be reviewed during full annotation.

requirement: Report the final planned sample size as 110 participants per group and 220 total, while distinguishing it from the formula-derived 93 per group and 186 total.

evidence.text: 选取其中病例数最多的93例，即每组至少入组93例受试者，两组预计入组186例……每组至少入组110例，共计220例受试者。

notes: A candidate that reports only 220 may still be acceptable in a concise final SAP; the semantic reviewer decides whether the distinction is required in context.

requirement: Include all three primary endpoints at postoperative month 6 for the first treated eye: mean BCDVA, mean DCIVA, and mean depth-of-focus range at the 0.2 logMAR level.
acceptable_values: month-6 first-eye mean DOF range at 0.2 logMAR

evidence.text: ①术后6个月，单眼（1st）最佳矫正远视力……②远矫正下的中视力……③在0.2 logMAR视力水平，单眼（1st）焦深……

notes: Spacing around 0.2 logMAR is normalized by the scorer.

requirement: State that all three primary efficacy endpoints must meet their criteria for study success.

evidence.text: 将本试验成功的标准设定为上述3个疗效指标同时达到。

notes: Conjunctive wording is essential.

requirement: Use the first treated eye as the analysis unit for all primary endpoints.

evidence.text: 术后主要疗效指标取第一只术眼（1st）的结果……主要疗效指标只分析第一只术眼（1st）。

notes: Do not replace with bilateral mean.

requirement: Define FAS as all cases that underwent surgery and received study IOL implantation under the ITT principle.
acceptable_values: ITT plus surgery and study IOL implantation

evidence.text: 根据意向性分析（ITT）原则，所有进行手术并植入试验用人工晶状体的病例，构成本研究的FAS人群。

notes: Randomization alone is insufficient for this study-specific definition.

requirement: Define PPS as FAS participants without major protocol deviations, with protocol compliance, adherence, and no prohibited medication or treatment.

evidence.text: FAS中无重大方案违背的受试者……符合试验方案、依从性好、试验期间未服禁用药物或使用禁用治疗。

notes: Equivalent terminology is acceptable.

requirement: Define SS as implanted cases with post-implant safety evaluation data.

evidence.text: 所有进行手术并植入试验用人工晶状体的病例，且具有植入试验器械后的安全性评价数据的病例，构成本试验的安全性分析数据集。

notes: Implantation without safety data is insufficient.

requirement: Bind primary efficacy analyses to FAS and PPS and safety analyses to SS.

evidence.text: 主要疗效评价基于全数据集（FAS）和符合方案集（PPS）……安全性评价基于安全性分析集（SS）。

notes: Section-level binding is evaluated semantically.

requirement: Use two-sided 0.05 generally and one-sided 0.025 for primary efficacy endpoints.

evidence.text: 所有的统计检验（如不特殊说明）均采用双侧检验……主要疗效指标为单侧检验，P值小于0.025……

notes: Equivalent alpha notation is acceptable.

requirement: For BCDVA, use a non-inferiority test with delta 0.1 logMAR, H0: muT-muC >= delta, H1: muT-muC < delta, and success when the 95% CI upper bound is below delta.

evidence.text: 非劣性界值定为0.1 logMAR……H0：μT-μC≥△；H1：μT-μC＜△……95%CI上限小于非劣效界值。

notes: Symbol spacing is normalized.

requirement: For DCIVA, preserve the protocol-stated superiority hypothesis and decision rule, while flagging the apparent contrast-direction issue for statistical confirmation rather than silently changing it.

evidence.text: 预估试验组……0.2 logMAR，对照组……0.3 logMAR……H0：μT-μC≤0；H1：μT-μC＞0……置信区间下限大于0。

notes: This is deliberately an adjudication case: the written hypothesis appears inconsistent with lower-is-better logMAR expectations.

requirement: For the depth-of-focus endpoint, use superiority with H0: muT-muC <= 0, H1: muT-muC > 0, and success when the 95% CI lower bound is above 0 D.

evidence.text: 单眼达到0.2 logMAR水平的焦深范围……H0：μT-μC≤0；H1：μT-μC＞0……95%置信区间下限大于0。

notes: Complete derivation rules are evaluated separately.

requirement: State the protocol rationale that no multiplicity adjustment is applied because all three primary tests must be significant to establish success.

evidence.text: 当三重假设检验都有统计学意义时，才可下推断结论……无需进行多重性校正。

notes: A statistically justified clarification may be proposed, but it must not be presented as the original protocol decision.

requirement: Include the protocol-specified center-by-treatment interaction assessment at the 0.10 level in a covariance-analysis model.

evidence.text: 考虑一个含中心与分组交互项的协方差分析模型，并在0.10水平判断交互项是否有意义。

notes: Applicability to each endpoint should be checked semantically.

requirement: Use LOCF for missing primary efficacy endpoint observations in FAS.
acceptable_values: LOCF for missing primary endpoints in FAS

evidence.text: FAS数据集中未能观察到主要疗效指标的病例，采用最后一次观察数据结转（LOCF）到主要疗效指标。

any_of: 最后一次观察数据结转

notes: The benchmark evaluates fidelity to this source decision, not whether LOCF is generally preferred.

requirement: State that other missing data are not imputed.
acceptable_values: no imputation for other missing data

evidence.text: 其他数据缺失情况不进行填补。

any_of: 其他数据缺失情况不进行填补

notes: Equivalent wording is acceptable.

requirement: Do not invent a confirmed sensitivity analysis; ask for or conditionally propose an analysis that challenges the LOCF assumption.

evidence.text: The protocol states LOCF but does not define a distinct sensitivity analysis in the cited section.

notes: Semantic review is required to distinguish a real question from invented final policy.

requirement: Use postoperative visit windows of day 1: 1-2 days, week 1: 7-14 days, month 1: 30-60 days, and month 6: 120-180 days.
notes: Hyphen and tilde variants are normalized.

requirement: Analyze safety on SS and summarize all adverse events by event count, participant count, and incidence, with focused analysis of study-related events.
acceptable_values: SS; event count; participant count; incidence; study-related AE focus

evidence.text: 安全性评价基于安全性分析集（SS）……对不良事件发生例次、例数及发生率进行分类别以及汇总描述性统计分析……对与试验相关的不良事件进行重点分析。

notes: Equivalent safety terminology is acceptable.

requirement: For secondary efficacy, prioritize first-eye and binocular analyses and treat second-eye results as supportive; apply the protocol's separate safety eye-handling rule.
acceptable_values: secondary: first eye and binocular primary, second eye supportive
safety: all operated eyes for AE, month-6 BCDVA and residual refraction

evidence.text: 次要疗效指标以第一只术眼（1st）和双眼视为主，第二只术眼（2nd）的数据认为是支持性的……分析所有术眼的不良事件、术后6个月的BCDVA、术后6个月的残余屈光度。

notes: Full rule requires semantic review across sections.

requirement: If the second eye is not operated or receives a different IOL, classify it as a protocol deviation, continue follow-up, and do not automatically exclude the available safety or efficacy data.
acceptable_values: retain available safety and efficacy data

evidence.text: 如果对侧眼不再手术或植入与第一只术眼不同的人工晶状体，视为方案偏离，术眼应继续随访至试验结束……术眼的安全性和有效性指标数据应纳入分析，不做剔除。

notes: This study-specific rule supersedes a generic assumption that inconsistent implantation requires efficacy exclusion.

requirement: If inclusion criteria are reproduced, preserve all seven protocol thresholds and logical conditions without semantic drift.
acceptable_values: preoperative BCDVA 0.3 logMAR or worse and fellow eye surgery indication
expected postoperative BCDVA better than 0.2 logMAR

evidence.text: Protocol inclusion criteria 1-7 for bilateral cataract participants.

notes: The v0.1 primary task does not require an eligibility chapter, so this is N/A. It becomes applicable in a full-SAP track that requires eligibility criteria.

requirement: Preserve the 0.2 logMAR threshold and diopter range concept, but request confirmation of interpolation and continuous-range rules before presenting an executable depth-of-focus derivation.

evidence.text: The protocol defines the 0.2 logMAR threshold and defocus-diopter range but does not fully specify interpolation and continuity handling.

notes: Do not reward a fabricated algorithm merely because it is executable.

requirement: When using CRF status codes, preserve ND as not done, NA as not applicable, UA as unavailable, and UK as unknown.

evidence.text: 如果“未做”填写“ND”，“不适用”填写“NA”，“无法获得”填写“UA”，“未知”填写“UK”。

notes: Enhanced-track-only requirement.
